phases.clock: perf_hooks performance.now and GC entry startTime
phases.inclusive: Awaited wall intervals. Settlement includes persist, remove and returned; broadcast and wakeObserve may nest in publish. These columns overlap and are never summed.
phases.exclusive: Each outer-prune wall segment belongs to its first matching phase in exclusivePriority. GC is clipped to measured windows and assigned once. Unattributed includes work and awaited gaps outside wrapped phases.
phases.gc: Native GC-event wall intervals, not a CPU or stop-the-world pause claim. Warmup, queue construction and observer flush are outside measured prune windows.
